exact_error_budget.statement: For an E114 production approximation whose exact target is the boundary-flux expectation, the full approximation/numerical/certificate error must fit inside the same final raw MSE cap; no helper or certificate error is extra-budget.
exact_error_budget.deterministic_sufficient_condition: eps_compression + eps_remainder_certificate + eps_helpers <= 1.374772708486752e-4 in per-coordinate RMS norm
exact_error_budget.production_candidate_requirement: Candidate must report each nonzero deterministic error bound and any residual stochastic variance, with the combined bound satisfying the formula above.

exact_flop_budget.accounting_identity: F_total = F_boundary_core + F_state_or_compression + F_helpers + F_remainder_certificate + F_materialization + F_fallback

layered_on_authoritative_e105_e104_base.admissibility_formula: F_boundary_core + F_state_or_compression + F_helpers + F_remainder_certificate + F_materialization + F_fallback <= 136758472261

exact_flop_budget.rule: Helpers and the remainder certificate are billed inside these ceilings. A candidate may not quote core-only FLOPs.
